item.title: Self-Hosted DHCP High Availability: Kea HA vs ISC DHCP Failover vs Keepalived+dnsmasq
item.description: Running DHCP without redundancy is a single point of failure. When your DHCP server goes down, new devices cannot join the network, and existing clients lose their leases at renewal time. For any production environment — from enterprise campuses to homelabs — DHCP high availability is not optional.
